sentences.zh: 以上統為部額，不系以司。

translations.literal: The above were ministry quotas in all, not tied to departments.
translations.idiomatic: The above were ministry-wide quotas, not attached to individual departments.

sentences.zh: 正參領八人，同正參領四人。

translations.literal: Senior Staff Colonels eight; same-rank Senior Staff Colonels four.
translations.idiomatic: Eight Senior Staff Colonels and four same-rank Senior Staff Colonels.

sentences.zh: 副參領十有二人，同副參領六人。

translations.literal: Deputy Staff Colonels twelve; same-rank Deputy Staff Colonels six.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve Deputy Staff Colonels and six same-rank Deputy Staff Colonels.

sentences.zh: 協參領十有八人，同協參領八人。

translations.literal: Assistant Staff Colonels eighteen; same-rank Assistant Staff Colonels eight.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen Assistant Staff Colonels and eight same-rank Assistant Staff Colonels.

translations.literal: Quotas corresponded to bureau directors, vice directors, and section chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Their quotas matched those of bureau directors, vice directors, and section chiefs.

sentences.zh: 正軍校十有八人，同正軍校八人。

translations.literal: Senior Company Officers eighteen; same-rank Senior Company Officers eight.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen Senior Company Officers and eight same-rank Senior Company Officers.

sentences.zh: 副軍校二十有四人，同副軍校十有二人。

translations.literal: Deputy Company Officers twenty-four; same-rank Deputy Company Officers twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four Deputy Company Officers and twelve same-rank Deputy Company Officers.

sentences.zh: 協軍校三十有二人，同協軍校十有六人。

translations.literal: Assistant Company Officers thirty-two; same-rank Assistant Company Officers sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty-two Assistant Company Officers and sixteen same-rank Assistant Company Officers.

translations.literal: Quotas corresponded to seventh-, eighth-, and ninth-rank clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Their quotas matched those of seventh-, eighth-, and ninth-rank clerks.

translations.literal: Officials divided to assume each duty.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were assigned to fill each post according to rank.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，命慶親王奕劻領部事，非恆制。

translations.literal: Year 33, Prince Qing Yikuang was ordered to head ministry affairs; not a permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year (1907), Prince Qing Yikuang was ordered to head the ministry—an exceptional arrangement.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，修正陸軍官制，軍官自正參領以下，軍佐自副都統以下，並就所習科目，冠以各隊如馬、步、砲、工、輜、警察各隊，正、副協參領，正、副協軍校，司務長，及上士、中士、下士之類。

translations.literal: Xuantong year 1, revised army officer system: officers from Senior Staff Colonel down, adjutants from Deputy Commandant down, all according to branch of study prefixed with detachments such as cavalry, infantry, artillery, engineers, train, and police detachments; principal, deputy, and assistant staff colonels; principal, deputy, and assistant company officers; chief clerks; and senior, sergeant, and junior sergeant types.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong (1909) the army officer system was revised: from Senior Staff Colonel downward for officers and from Deputy Commandant downward for adjutants, titles took branch prefixes—cavalry, infantry, artillery, engineers, train, police, and the like—for staff colonels, company officers, chief clerks, and sergeants.

sentences.zh: 專門如軍需、軍醫、制械副協都統，正、副協都統，正、副協軍校，馬醫、測繪正、副協參領，正、副協軍校，軍樂協軍校，測繪、軍樂司務長，上、中、下各士，會計、調護上、中、下各士。

translations.literal: Specialized such as quartermaster, medical, ordnance-making deputy and assistant commandants; principal, deputy, and assistant commandants; principal, deputy, and assistant company officers; veterinary and surveying principal and deputy assistant staff colonels; principal and deputy company officers; band assistant company officer; surveying and band chief clerks; senior, sergeant, and junior sergeants of each type; accounting and nursing senior, sergeant, and junior sergeants.
translations.idiomatic: Specialist branches included quartermaster, medical, and ordnance deputy and assistant commandants; line commandants; line company officers; veterinary and surveying staff colonels and company officers; band assistant company officers; surveying and band chief clerks; and accounting and nursing sergeants of all grades.

translations.literal: Titles cut the character tong ['same-rank'].
translations.idiomatic: The character tong ('same-rank') was dropped from titles.

sentences.zh: 二年，改尚書為大臣，侍郎為副大臣。

translations.literal: Year 2, changed Shangshu to Dachen, Shilang to Vice Dachen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1910) the shangshu was retitled minister (dachen) and the shilang vice minister (fu dachen).

sentences.zh: 省左、右丞，參議，諮議，承發各官。

translations.literal: Abolished Left and Right Vice Directors, Counselors, advisory officers, and dispatch officers.
translations.idiomatic: The left and right vice directors, counselors, advisory officers, and dispatch officers were abolished.

translations.literal: Merged two [offices] and ten departments into eight departments.
translations.idiomatic: Two offices and ten departments were consolidated into eight.

sentences.zh: 增承政一司，省軍乘、軍計、軍學三司。

translations.literal: Added one Secretariat department; abolished Transport, Accounts, and Military Education three departments.
translations.idiomatic: One Secretariat department was added; Transport, Accounts, and Military Education were abolished.

translations.literal: Established Military Education and Audit two offices.
translations.idiomatic: Military Education and Audit offices were established.

sentences.zh: 明年，定陸軍官佐補充制，置部副官調查員，以軍實司省入軍制，改軍牧司、軍學處為暫設，冀樹軍馬總監、軍學院基礎也。

translations.literal: Next year, fixed army officer and adjutant filling system; established ministry deputy adjutants and investigators; Ordnance Department abolished and merged into Organization; Remount Department and Military Education Office changed to provisional, hoping to lay foundations for a Remount Directorate and Military Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the system for filling army officers and adjutants was fixed; ministry deputy adjutants and investigators were added; the Ordnance Department was merged into Organization; and the Remount Department and Military Education Office were made provisional, to lay groundwork for a Remount Directorate and a military academy.

sentences.zh: 三年，復定陸軍官佐充任制，如前所列。

translations.literal: Year 3, again fixed army officer and adjutant appointment system, as listed above.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1911) the appointment system for army officers and adjutants was again fixed as listed above.

translations.literal: Still intermixed and used interchangeably with old department staff.
translations.idiomatic: They were still used interchangeably with staff of the old departments.

translations.literal: Navy Minister, Senior Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The Navy Minister held the rank of Senior Commandant.

translations.literal: Vice Minister, Deputy Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister held the rank of Deputy Commandant.

translations.literal: Each one person.
translations.idiomatic: One of each.

sentences.zh: 一等參謀官二人，二等四人。

translations.literal: First-class staff officers two persons; second-class four.
translations.idiomatic: There were two first-class and four second-class staff officers.

translations.literal: Filled by naval cadets.
translations.idiomatic: Naval cadets filled these posts.

translations.literal: Counselor officers two persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were two counselor officers.

translations.literal: Secretary officers six persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were six secretary officers.

translations.literal: Filled by officers of equivalent qualification and civil officials.
translations.idiomatic: Officers of comparable standing and civil officials filled these posts.

sentences.zh: 司電員，藝師，藝士，酌用海軍官佐或文官學生。

translations.literal: Telegraph operators, master artisans, and artisans: navy officers, adjutants, or civil student trainees used as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Telegraph operators, master artisans, and artisans were drawn as appropriate from naval officers, adjutants, or civil trainees.

sentences.zh: 錄事，酌用文官學生及額外軍官、軍佐。

translations.literal: Record clerks: civil student trainees and supernumerary officers and adjutants used as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Record clerks were drawn as appropriate from civil trainees and supernumerary officers and adjutants.

translations.literal: No fixed quota.
translations.idiomatic: There was no fixed quota.

sentences.zh: 軍制、軍政、軍學、軍樞、軍儲、軍法、軍醫七司，各司長一人。

translations.literal: Organization, Naval Administration, Naval Education, Naval Secretariat, Naval Supply, Military Justice, and Medical seven departments, each one director.
translations.idiomatic: Seven departments—Organization, Naval Administration, Naval Education, Naval Secretariat, Naval Supply, Military Justice, and Medical—each had one director.

translations.literal: Filled by Assistant Commandant and Senior Staff Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant Commandants and Senior Staff Colonels filled these posts.

sentences.zh: 科長二十有一人，軍制科五：曰制度，曰考覈，曰銓衡，曰駕駛，曰輪機。

translations.literal: Section chiefs twenty-one persons; Organization sections five: called Regulations, Examination, Selection, Navigation, and Engineering.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty-one section chiefs. Organization had five sections: Regulations, Examination, Selection, Navigation, and Engineering.

sentences.zh: 軍政科三：曰製造，曰建築，曰器械。

translations.literal: Naval Administration sections three: called Manufacturing, Construction, and Ordnance.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Administration had three: Manufacturing, Construction, and Ordnance.

sentences.zh: 軍學科五：曰教育，曰訓練，曰謀略，曰偵測，曰編譯。

translations.literal: Naval Education sections five: called Education, Training, Strategy, Reconnaissance, and Compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Education had five: Education, Training, Strategy, Reconnaissance, and Compilation.

sentences.zh: 軍樞科三：曰奏咨，曰典章，曰承發。

translations.literal: Naval Secretariat sections three: called Memorials and Consultations, Regulations and Archives, and Dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: The Naval Secretariat had three: Memorials and Consultations, Regulations and Archives, and Dispatch.

sentences.zh: 軍儲科三：曰收支，曰儲備，曰庶務。

translations.literal: Naval Supply sections three: called Receipt and Disbursement, Storage, and General Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Supply had three: Receipt and Disbursement, Storage, and General Affairs.

sentences.zh: 軍醫科二：曰醫務，曰衛生。

translations.literal: Medical sections two: called Medical Affairs and Hygiene.
translations.idiomatic: Medical had two: Medical Affairs and Hygiene.

translations.literal: Each section one person.
translations.idiomatic: One chief per section.

translations.literal: Filled by Senior and Deputy Staff Colonels.
translations.idiomatic: Senior and Deputy Staff Colonels filled these posts.

translations.literal: Same below.
translations.idiomatic: The same applied below.

translations.literal: First-, second-, and third-class section members sixty persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were sixty section members of three grades.

translations.literal: Organization and Naval Education each fourteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Organization and Naval Education had fourteen each.

translations.literal: Naval Secretariat and Naval Supply each ten persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Naval Secretariat and Naval Supply had ten each.

translations.literal: Naval Administration eight persons.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Administration had eight.

translations.literal: Medical four persons.
translations.idiomatic: Medical had four.

translations.literal: Appointments as in the Army Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments followed the Army Ministry pattern.

sentences.zh: 一等司法官二人，二、三等司法官，學習司法官八人。

translations.literal: First-class judicial officers two; second- and third-class judicial officers and trainee judicial officers eight.
translations.idiomatic: There were two first-class judicial officers and eight second-, third-class, and trainee judicial officers.

translations.literal: Filled by legally trained army officers.
translations.idiomatic: Legally trained army officers filled these posts.

translations.literal: Comptroller's Office chief accountant one person.
translations.idiomatic: The Comptroller's Office had one chief accountant.

translations.literal: Filled by Senior Staff Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: A Senior Staff Colonel filled the post.

translations.literal: Section chiefs two persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were two section chiefs.

translations.literal: Accounting and Statistics sections each one person.
translations.idiomatic: One each for Accounting and Statistics.

sentences.zh: 各司處錄事四十有八人。

translations.literal: Record clerks of various departments and offices forty-eight persons.
translations.idiomatic: Record clerks for the various departments and offices numbered forty-eight.

sentences.zh: 大臣掌主海軍，稽覈水師及司令部，以固海疆。

translations.literal: Minister presided over the navy, examined the fleet and headquarters, to secure the maritime frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The minister directed the navy, audited the fleet and headquarters, and secured the maritime frontier.

translations.literal: Vice minister assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister assisted him.

translations.literal: Staff officers managed consultation and revision of reforms.
translations.idiomatic: Staff officers handled consultation and revision of reforms.

translations.literal: Counselors managed laws and regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Counselors handled laws and institutional regulations.

translations.literal: Secretaries managed confidential documents.
translations.idiomatic: Secretaries handled confidential correspondence.

sentences.zh: 軍制掌規制銓法，旌別水師人員，功過、封廕、賞恤並典領之。

translations.literal: Organization managed regulations and selection law, distinguished naval personnel merit and fault, enfeoffment yin, rewards and pensions all directed by it.
translations.idiomatic: Organization managed regulations and selection rules, marked naval personnel's merits and faults, and oversaw enfeoffments, yin privileges, rewards, and pensions.

sentences.zh: 軍政掌營造船艦，檢校器械，兼司軍港工程。

translations.literal: Naval Administration managed building ships, inspecting ordnance, and also naval port engineering.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Administration managed shipbuilding, ordnance inspection, and naval port works.

sentences.zh: 軍學掌學校教育，艦隊訓練。

translations.literal: Naval Education managed school instruction and fleet training.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Education managed schools and fleet training.

sentences.zh: 軍樞掌文牘典章，匯紀員司集課文簿。

translations.literal: Naval Secretariat managed documents and archives, compiled staff assembly and lesson records.
translations.idiomatic: The Naval Secretariat managed documents and archives and compiled staff records and training logs.

sentences.zh: 軍儲掌經營費用，稽覈糧廩服裝與其物用。

translations.literal: Naval Supply managed operating expenses, examined grain stores, clothing, and their materiel use.
translations.idiomatic: Naval Supply managed operating funds and audited grain stores, clothing, and materiel.

sentences.zh: 軍法、軍醫、主計職掌視陸軍部。

translations.literal: Military Justice, Medical, and Comptroller duties as in Army Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Military Justice, Medical, and Comptroller duties matched those of the Army Ministry.

sentences.zh: 光緒十一年，詔設海軍衙門，依軍機總署例，命醇親奕枻綜之，大學士李鴻章專司籌辦。

translations.literal: Guangxu year 11, edict established Naval Yamen, following Grand Council precedent; ordered Prince Chun Yihui to oversee it, Grand Secretary Li Hongzhang exclusively to manage planning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Guangxu (1885) an edict established the Naval Yamen on the Grand Council model, with Prince Chun Yihui in overall charge and Grand Secretary Li Hongzhang in charge of planning.

sentences.zh: 十三年，北洋海軍成，置提督、總兵等官。

translations.literal: Year 13, Beiyang Navy completed; established admiral, regional commander, and other posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year (1887) the Beiyang Fleet was completed and admirals, regional commanders, and other posts were established.

translations.literal: Jiawu [war]: the fleet destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiawu War (1894–95) the fleet was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 至三十三年，始議恢復，設海軍處，暫隸陸軍部。

translations.literal: By year 33, restoration first discussed; established Naval Office, temporarily subordinate to Army Ministry.
translations.idiomatic: Not until the thirty-third year (1907) was restoration discussed; a Naval Office was set up, temporarily under the Army Ministry.

translations.literal: Established director, rank equivalent to Assistant Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: A director was appointed, equivalent to an Assistant Commandant.

translations.literal: Deputy director, rank equivalent to Senior Staff Colonel.
translations.idiomatic: A deputy director was appointed, equivalent to a Senior Staff Colonel.

translations.literal: Each one person.
translations.idiomatic: One of each.

translations.literal: Dispatch officers two; record clerks four.
translations.idiomatic: There were two dispatch officers and four record clerks.

sentences.zh: 設機要、船政、運籌三司，置司長、副官各一人。

translations.literal: Established Secret Affairs, Ship Administration, and Planning three departments; director and deputy adjutant each one person.
translations.idiomatic: Three departments were set up—Secret Affairs, Ship Administration, and Planning—each with one director and one deputy adjutant.

sentences.zh: 科長七人，機要科四：曰制度，曰籌械，曰駕馭，曰輪機。

translations.literal: Section chiefs seven; Secret Affairs sections four: called Regulations, Ordnance Planning, Navigation, and Engineering.
translations.idiomatic: There were seven section chiefs. Secret Affairs had four sections: Regulations, Ordnance Planning, Navigation, and Engineering.

sentences.zh: 運籌科三：曰謀略，曰教務，曰測海。

translations.literal: Planning sections three: called Strategy, Instruction, and Hydrography.
translations.idiomatic: Planning had three: Strategy, Instruction, and Hydrography.

translations.literal: Each section one person.
translations.idiomatic: One per section.

translations.literal: Ship Administration undivided into sections.
translations.idiomatic: Ship Administration had no subdivisions.

translations.literal: Dispatch officers three; each department one.
translations.idiomatic: There were three dispatch officers, one per department.

sentences.zh: 一、二、三等科員十有八人。

translations.literal: First-, second-, and third-class section members eighteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were eighteen section members of three grades.

translations.literal: Secret Affairs twelve; Planning six.
translations.idiomatic: Secret Affairs had twelve; Planning six.

translations.literal: Examination and works officers five; established by Ship Administration Department.
translations.idiomatic: Five examination and works officers were assigned by the Ship Administration Department.

sentences.zh: 藝師三人，船政一人，運籌二人。

translations.literal: Master artisans three; Ship Administration one; Planning two.
translations.idiomatic: There were three master artisans: one in Ship Administration and two in Planning.

translations.literal: Artisans four persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were four artisans.

translations.literal: Ship Administration and Planning each two persons.
translations.idiomatic: Ship Administration and Planning had two each.

sentences.zh: 股長、股員，視事閒劇酌置。

translations.literal: Section heads and members placed according to business light or heavy as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Section heads and members were assigned according to workload.

translations.literal: Record clerks eighteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were eighteen record clerks.

sentences.zh: 明年，改設海政、船政、籌備、儲蓄、醫務、法務六司。

translations.literal: Next year, reorganized as Naval Administration, Ship Administration, Preparation, Storage, Medical Affairs, and Legal Affairs six departments.
translations.idiomatic: The following year six departments were established: Naval Administration, Ship Administration, Preparation, Storage, Medical Affairs, and Legal Affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋設主計處，置計長、副長各一人。

translations.literal: Soon established Comptroller's Office; chief and deputy chief accountant each one person.
translations.idiomatic: A Comptroller's Office was soon added with one chief and one deputy chief accountant.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，命肅親王善耆等籌備海軍，設參贊□，分秘書、庶務兩司，置一、二、三等參謀官，並設第一、第二、第三、第四四司，置司長以下各職。

translations.literal: Xuantong year 1, ordered Prince Su Shanqi and others to prepare the navy; established Advisory [Office]; divided into Secretariat and General Affairs two departments; appointed first-, second-, and third-class staff officers; and established First, Second, Third, and Fourth four departments, with directors and subordinate posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuantong (1909) Prince Su Shanqi and others were ordered to prepare the navy. An advisory office was set up with Secretariat and General Affairs departments, staff officers of three grades, and four numbered departments with directors and subordinate posts.

sentences.zh: 其夏，更命貝勒載濤等充籌辦海軍大臣，增設醫務司。

translations.literal: That summer, again ordered Prince Zaitao and others as preparatory navy ministers; added Medical Affairs Department.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Prince Zaitao and others were appointed preparatory navy ministers and a Medical Affairs Department was added.

sentences.zh: 二年，訂海軍暫行官制，改第一司曰軍制，第二司曰軍政，第三司曰軍學，第四曰軍防，醫務司曰軍醫，秘書司曰軍樞，庶務司曰軍儲；

translations.literal: Year 2, fixed provisional navy official system: changed First Department to Organization, Second to Naval Administration, Third to Naval Education, Fourth to Coastal Defense; Medical Affairs to Medical; Secretariat to Naval Secretariat; General Affairs to Naval Supply;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1910) a provisional navy official system was adopted: the first department became Organization, the second Naval Administration, the third Naval Education, the fourth Coastal Defense; Medical Affairs became Medical; Secretariat became Naval Secretariat; General Affairs became Naval Supply;

sentences.zh: 別設軍法一司，是為八司。

translations.literal: Separately established Military Justice one department; this made eight departments.
translations.idiomatic: and Military Justice was added separately, for eight departments in all.

translations.literal: Abolished Advisory [Office] and all its posts.
translations.idiomatic: The advisory office and its posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 尋改處為部，省軍防司，置大臣、副大臣各一人。

translations.literal: Soon changed Office to Ministry; abolished Coastal Defense Department; established Dachen and Vice Dachen each one person.
translations.idiomatic: The office was soon upgraded to a ministry; Coastal Defense was abolished; and one minister and one vice minister were appointed.

sentences.zh: 司法大臣，副大臣，各一人。

translations.literal: Judicial Minister, Vice Minister, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: There were one judicial minister and one vice minister.

translations.literal: Left and Right Vice Directors, Counselor, each one person.
translations.idiomatic: One left vice director, one right vice director, and one counselor.

translations.literal: Counselors four persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were four counselors.

sentences.zh: 審錄、制勘、編置、宥恤、舉敘、典獄、會計、都事八司，郎中二十有五人，審錄四人，內宗室一缺。

translations.idiomatic: Eight departments—Trial Review, Sentence Determination, Banishment Assignment, Clemency, Promotion Records, Prisons, Accounts, and General Affairs—had twenty-five bureau directors; Trial Review had four, including one reserved for the Imperial Clan.

translations.literal: The rest each three persons.
translations.idiomatic: All others had three each.

sentences.zh: 員外郎三十有四人，制勘、編置各五人，內宗室各一缺。

translations.literal: Vice directors thirty-four; Sentence Determination and Banishment Assignment each five, each including one Imperial Clan slot.
translations.idiomatic: There were thirty-four vice directors; Sentence Determination and Banishment Assignment had five each, with one Imperial Clan slot in each.

translations.literal: The rest all four persons.
translations.idiomatic: All others had four.

translations.literal: Section chiefs thirty-three persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were thirty-three section chiefs.

translations.literal: Clemency five persons, including one Imperial Clan slot.
translations.idiomatic: Clemency had five, including one Imperial Clan slot.

translations.literal: The rest all four persons.
translations.idiomatic: All others had four.

sentences.zh: 收發所員外郎、主事各二人。

translations.literal: Dispatch Office vice directors and section chiefs each two persons.
translations.idiomatic: The Dispatch Office had two vice directors and two section chiefs.

sentences.zh: 七品小京官二十有六人。

translations.literal: Seventh-rank junior capital officials twenty-six persons.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty-six seventh-rank junior capital officials.

translations.literal: Including two Imperial Clan slots.
translations.idiomatic: Two were reserved for the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 八品錄事五十有三人，九品三十人。

translations.idiomatic: There were fifty-three eighth-rank record clerks and thirty ninth-rank clerks.

translations.literal: Each including two Imperial Clan slots.
translations.idiomatic: Each grade included two Imperial Clan slots.

sentences.zh: 大臣掌主法職，監督大理院及京、外審判、檢察，以維法治。

translations.literal: Minister presided over judicial duties, supervised Supreme Court and capital and provincial trial and prosecution, to uphold rule of law.
translations.idiomatic: The minister directed judicial administration, supervised the Supreme Court of Justice and trial and prosecution offices in the capital and provinces, and upheld the rule of law.

translations.literal: Vice minister assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister assisted him.

sentences.zh: 審錄掌朝審錄囚，覆覈大理院、審判廳刑名。

translations.literal: Trial Review managed court trial and prisoner review, re-examined criminal cases of Supreme Court and trial chambers.
translations.idiomatic: Trial Review conducted court trials and prisoner reviews and re-examined criminal cases from the Supreme Court and trial chambers.

translations.literal: Also examined case reports of Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Left Wing Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: It also audited case reports from Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangdong, Guangxi, and the Left Wing of Chahar.

sentences.zh: 制勘掌秋錄實緩，定科刑禁。

translations.literal: Sentence Determination managed autumn review real and reprieved, fixed statutory penalties and prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Sentence Determination handled autumn review classifications of capital and reprieved sentences and fixed statutory penalties.

sentences.zh: 兼稽四川、河南、陝西、甘肅、新疆、烏裡雅蘇台、科布多案狀。

translations.literal: Also examined case reports of Sichuan, Henan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Xinjiang, Uliastai, and Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: It also audited case reports from Sichuan, Henan, Shaanxi, Gansu, Xinjiang, Uliastai, and Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 編置掌盜犯減等，定地編發。

translations.idiomatic: Banishment Assignment handled sentence reductions for theft convicts and fixed local banishment assignments.

sentences.zh: 兼稽奉天、吉林、黑龍江、山東、山西、察哈爾右翼、綏遠城、歸化城案狀。

translations.literal: Also examined case reports of Fengtian, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Shanxi, Right Wing Chahar, Suiyuan City, and Guihua City.
translations.idiomatic: It also audited case reports from Fengtian, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Shandong, Shanxi, the Right Wing of Chahar, Suiyuan, and Guihua.

sentences.zh: 宥恤掌恩詔赦典，清理庶獄。

translations.literal: Also examined case reports of Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, Hubei, and Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: It also audited case reports from Jiangsu, Anhui, Jiangxi, Fujian, Zhejiang, Hubei, and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 舉敘掌陞遷調補，籍紀功罪，徵考法官、律師、書記。

translations.idiomatic: Promotion Records managed promotions and transfers, recorded merits and offenses, and examined judges, lawyers, and clerks.

sentences.zh: 典獄掌修葺囹圄，嚴固扃鑰，習藝所俘隸簿錄並典司之。

translations.literal: Prisons managed repair of prisons, strict locks and keys, handicraft institute convict labor registers all directed by it.
translations.idiomatic: The Prisons Department maintained prisons and locks, and oversaw handicraft institutes and convict registers.

sentences.zh: 會計掌財用出入，勾稽罰鍰鈞金。

translations.literal: Accounts managed financial receipts and disbursements, examined fines and confiscated gold.
translations.idiomatic: Accounts managed revenues and expenditures and audited fines and confiscated gold.

sentences.zh: 都事掌絲番譯章奏，收發罪囚文移。

translations.literal: General Affairs managed Manchu translation of memorials, receipt and dispatch of prisoner documents.
translations.idiomatic: General Affairs handled Manchu translation of memorials and the receipt and dispatch of prisoner documents.

translations.idiomatic: The former Detention Office had Prisons Department vice directors and section chiefs serving concurrently as chief supervisor wardens.

translations.idiomatic: The Associate Chief Justice assisted him.

translations.idiomatic: Presiding judges handled civil and criminal dockets respectively and deliberated on doubtful cases.

sentences.zh: 刑科掌被旨推鞫宗室官犯，披詳刑事京控上訴法狀。

translations.idiomatic: The Criminal Division conducted imperially ordered interrogations of Imperial Clan officials and reviewed criminal appeals filed in the capital.

translations.idiomatic: The Civil Division handled Imperial Clan disputes and reviewed civil appeals filed in the capital.

translations.idiomatic: An Archives Office and subordinate officials were also established.

translations.idiomatic: A detention house was established with a director and other officials.

translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1911) a chief archivist was added to the Procuratorate General, and record clerks were set at two each for the eighth and ninth ranks.

translations.idiomatic: Filled by special imperial selection.

translations.idiomatic: The vice minister assisted him.

translations.idiomatic: The Protection and Benefit Bureau became Commerce.

translations.idiomatic: In 1904 (Guangxu 30) provinces created Training Offices with equipment, staff, and drill departments.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，改設科、局，仿陸軍新制，任官授職。

translations.idiomatic: Army, division, brigade, and regiment once all had clerks; later abolished.

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Guangxu new-army drilling divided the realm into thirty-six divisions and fixed division, brigade, regiment, and battalion ranks.
translations.idiomatic: In 1904 (Guangxu 30) new-army reforms planned thirty-six divisions with fixed division-through-battalion ranks.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，各省先後編混成等協，暫置執法官、司事生各一人，尋省。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong provinces organized mixed brigades with temporary executive officers and clerks, soon abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 (Xuantong 1) provinces formed mixed brigades with temporary executives, soon abolished.

sentences.zh: 三年，報成鎮者二十有六，置總統一人。

translations.literal: In the third year twenty-six divisions were reported complete and one commander-in-chief appointed.
translations.idiomatic: By 1911 (Xuantong 3) twenty-six divisions were reported complete with one commander-in-chief.

translations.literal: Chief of staff and below remained vacant.
translations.idiomatic: Chief of staff and subordinate posts remained unfilled.

sentences.zh: 餘或成二協，或一協一標，鎮數未全。

translations.literal: Others had only two brigades, or one brigade and one regiment; divisions were not complete.
translations.idiomatic: Others had only two brigades or one brigade and one regiment; the thirty-six-division plan was unfinished.

sentences.zh: 陸軍鎮監，監長，協參領、正軍校充。

translations.idiomatic: Army division prison warden and chief warden of staff-colonel or field-officer rank.

sentences.zh: 以上各員，俱綠營將弁兼充。

sentences.zh: 光緒三十三年，以防練舊營雜項隊伍章制不一，仿新軍成法，置統領以次各職。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year of Guangxu, because defense training and miscellaneous old units lacked uniform regulations, patrol forces were organized on the new-army model with commanders downward.
translations.idiomatic: In 1907 (Guangxu 33) heterogeneous defense units were reorganized as patrol forces on the new-army model.

translations.idiomatic: Captain and chief engineer of the Haixi cruiser: senior staff officer.

sentences.zh: 一等參謀官，海籌、海琛、海容巡洋艦，南琛、鏡清、通濟練船，江元、江利、楚同、楚泰、楚有、江員砲船，保民運船諸管帶，副參領。

translations.idiomatic: Junior staff officers commanded listed cruisers, training ships, gunboats, and the Baomin transport.

sentences.zh: 飛鷹魚雷獵船，建威、建安魚雷砲船，江亨、楚謙、楚豫、聯鯨、楚觀、舞鳳砲船諸管帶，協參領。
